Breaking apart a nug fills the room with a loud aroma of baked goods, toasted nuts, and sweet vanilla, closely followed by a heavy, classic OG back-end of damp earth, woody pine, and a sharp hint of diesel fuel. On the inhale, the smoke is remarkably thick, smooth, and expansive, coating the tongue in a rich, buttery cookie dough flavor.
